title: The matched q^6 coefficient uniquely selects the remaining second-order two-radius chart motion
scope: The regular matched path through K1727's isolated bounded symmetric two-radius equality seed, after K1738's unique first chart velocity and beta=0 condition.

gu_typed_objects.carrier: the symmetric four-atom law on plus-or-minus sqrt(a) and plus-or-minus sqrt(b), with weights p/2 and (1-p)/2 and b=(1-pa)/(1-p)
gu_typed_objects.map: the local analytic chart (p,a) -> (r,x) with r=kappa_6/u^(3/2), x=h_8/u^2 and u=-kappa_4
gu_typed_objects.quantifiers: regular analytic chart paths sufficiently near the K1727 equality seed
gu_typed_objects.owner: repository-internal scalar-channel construction; no source-owned physical state or global variational problem

matched_composition.eleven_halves_selection: This coefficient is independent of eta and gamma, so q^(11/2) cannot resolve K1738's remaining second-order chart freedom.

chart_selection.first_velocity: K1738 fixes r_1=35/3 and x_1=0, equivalently the unique (P,A) chart velocity.
chart_selection.second_order: K1737 fixes r_2=beta=0; K1742 fixes x_2=eta_*. Because det d(kappa_6,x)/d(p,a) is nonzero at the seed, these two exact invariant conditions determine the two second-order chart coefficients uniquely.
chart_selection.third_order_boundary: The q^6 law also fixes r_3=gamma_* but is independent of x_3=theta. One third-order chart degree of freedom therefore remains; no complete analytic branch is selected.

scope_guard: The selector is exact only for regular local two-radius paths at the K1727 equality seed. It does not give a uniform moving-seed remainder, interval-controlled finite-strength comparison, remote-boundary exclusion, an all-seed optimizer, or any source-owned physical conclusion.
